company.name: United Arab Bank
company.shortDescription: United Arab Bank is a Financial company specializes in financial services industries and retail banking solutions.
company.description: United Arab Bank is a commercial banking and financial services company that offers retail, corporate, and capital markets solutions. Its products and services include deposit accounts, loans, credit and debit cards, trade and supply chain finance, treasury services, and digital banking, along with Shari’ah-compliant finance and wealth-related solutions for individual and business clients.
founders: H.E. Sheikh Faisal Bin Sultan Bin Salem Al Qassimi
